intro.en: Describing a building, a sculpture or a painting, and placing it in its style.

texto.en:
**Architecture.** A building has **una fachada**, **columnas**, **arcos**, **una torre**, sometimes **una cúpula**. In Spain you will meet four words again and again: **románico** (11th–12th centuries: thick walls, round arches), **gótico** (13th–15th: height, pointed arches, stained glass), **renacentista** (16th) and **barroco** (17th–18th: movement and decoration). And one that is only Spanish: **mudéjar**, Christian buildings in the Islamic style.

**Sculpture.** **Una estatua** or **una escultura de mármol**, **de bronce**, **de madera**, **de barro**. The material takes **de**.

**Painting.** **Un cuadro** is painted **al óleo** or **a la acuarela**, on **un lienzo**. Kinds: **un retrato**, **un autorretrato**, **un paisaje**, **un bodegón** (a still life). Styles: **realista**, **impresionista**, **cubista**, **abstracto**.

**Describing a painting.** **En primer plano** (in the foreground), **al fondo**, **a la izquierda**, **en el centro**. **Aparece**, **se ve**, **representa**. **La luz**, **el color**, **la composición**.

**Judging.** **Una obra maestra.** **Una obra representativa de** su época. **Tiene un estilo propio.** **Transmite** calma, **expresa** dolor.

**Passive with se** is the natural way to give facts: **se construyó** en el siglo XIII; **se pintó** en 1656; **se conserva** en el Prado; **se restauró** hace poco.

frases.es: Las Meninas, que Velázquez pintó al óleo en 1656, se considera una de las obras maestras de la pintura europea.
frases.en: Las Meninas, which Velázquez painted in oils in 1656, is considered one of the masterpieces of European painting.

frases.es: El lienzo, de más de tres metros de alto, se conserva en el Museo del Prado, en Madrid.
frases.en: The canvas, more than three metres high, is kept in the Prado Museum in Madrid.
analisis: de más de tres metros de alto

frases.es: En el centro aparece la infanta Margarita, de cinco años, rodeada de las jóvenes que la atienden.
frases.en: In the centre appears the Infanta Margarita, aged five, surrounded by the young women who attend her.

frases.es: A la izquierda, el propio pintor nos mira con el pincel en la mano, delante de un lienzo del que solo vemos la parte de atrás.
frases.en: On the left, the painter himself looks at us with the brush in his hand, in front of a canvas of which we see only the back.
analisis: con el pincel en la mano
del que solo vemos la parte de atrás

frases.es: Al fondo, un espejo refleja a los reyes, como si estuvieran exactamente donde estamos nosotros.
frases.en: In the background, a mirror reflects the king and queen, as if they were exactly where we are.

frases.es: De ahí que nadie sepa con certeza quién mira a quién, ni qué cuadro está pintando Velázquez.
frases.en: Hence nobody knows for certain who is looking at whom, nor which picture Velázquez is painting.
analisis: ni qué cuadro está pintando Velázquez

frases.es: Tres siglos después, Picasso quedó tan fascinado por el cuadro que pintó más de cincuenta versiones.
frases.en: Three centuries later, Picasso was so fascinated by the painting that he painted more than fifty versions.
analisis: quedó tan fascinado por el cuadro que

pregunta.en: According to the text, who is reflected in the mirror?

The king and queen.en: Un espejo refleja a los reyes.

The painter.en: He is on the left, looking at us.

pregunta.en: According to the text, what is mysterious about the painting?

Nobody knows who is looking at whom.en: Nadie sabe con certeza quién mira a quién.

bloques.correcta: Nobody knows who is looking at whom

pregunta.en: A painting of a person's face is…

sepa.en: De ahí que takes the subjunctive.

sabrá.en: De ahí que takes the subjunctive.

bloques.frase: La catedral se construyó en el siglo XIII.

texto.en: The cathedral was built in the thirteenth century.
The cathedral built itself in the third century.

explicacion.en: Se construyó is a passive, and XIII is thirteen.

texto.en: The cathedral is being built in the thirteenth century.

bloques.frase: Al fondo se ve una iglesia de estilo gótico

traduccion.en: In the background you can see a church in the Gothic style.

texto.en:
**The app cannot check this part.** For the writing, please use pen and paper. For the speaking, say it out loud and, if you can, practise with a native speaker or a teacher who can correct you.

**Write (150–180 words).** Describe a painting or a building in detail: what is in it, how it is organised and what it conveys.

**Speak (about 3 minutes).** Describe a picture aloud to someone who cannot see it, from the foreground to the background.
